title: Can't Catch Me!
description: Zigzag through frantic cartoon arenas dodging hungry chasers—lure pursuers into bumping each other and snag power-ups to survive as long as possible.
controls: Drag to weave swiftly around pursuing enemies, trigger traps, and collect bonus coins.

zh-CN.title: 吃不到我呀
zh-CN.description: 高画质魔性走位躲避吃不到我呀：在满场追兵围堵下风骚蛇皮走位，诱敌互撞狂捡道具极限存活刷高分！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动灵活蛇皮走位躲避四周追捕，巧用道具与陷阱坚持存活拿高分。
